summary: Lock GINI(30,th.50) bootstrap screen from the search; run 3x5 nested CV of screen+RF on pilot only, writing cv_auc and n_features to out/metrics.json (screen milestone)
reasoning: My pilot-only search (step-51, built on fleet1 stable-forest's design) evaluated F(20/30/40) vs GINI(30) bootstrap-stability screens by honest 2x5 nested CV: GINI(30,th>0.5) won with cv_auc 0.7590 +- 0.0315, keeping a 10-feature majority set (x65,x106,x129,x159,x242,x337,x339,x360,x445,x476; seed-Jaccard 1.0). Locking that procedure and re-estimating with 3x5 repeated nested CV (screen refit inside every outer fold, so no selection leakage like the inherited analysis) should land cv_auc near the search's 0.759, comfortably above the 0.70 milestone floor. The fleet2-vote trail independently found a pilot-only screen + model at cv_auc 0.73, corroborating that this regime is reachable. n_features is the full-pilot majority set size, 10 <= 50. Expect: cv_auc >= 0.7, n_features <= 50. If cv_auc comes back below 0.7, the plan is contradicted and I will return to pilot-only evidence.
